title: Formal literature-reference maintenance policy for proof and publication lanes
question: How should external literature, legacy sources, internal verification, and publication references be recorded so that prior art is not mistaken for a TECT result or omitted from future synthesis PDFs?
method: Define a mandatory source record containing citation, stable locator, exact theorem location, version/hash, imported conclusion, hypothesis crosswalk, applicability disposition and consuming proof step.
Separate manifest/certificate provenance, claim-card applicability, gate-level synthesis PDF references and exploration-ledger source exclusions.
Require explicit prior-art, TECT-specific contribution and non-claim sections before publication-level novelty or physical interpretation language.
Preserve selected legacy sources by path/hash/source ID and keep superseded or refuted conclusions reference-only until revalidation.
finding: The repository already has a literature-first applicability gate, but its records and intermediate proof certificates do not uniformly provide a publication-grade bibliography. The new policy closes that process gap by making source IDs, precise locators, assumption crosswalks, applicability dispositions and PDF reference completeness mandatory for load-bearing imports while retaining the no-per-lemma-PDF economy.
decision_reason: This is a process and provenance policy, not a mathematical result. It makes future documents auditable and prevents standard prior art, finite internal checks and legacy evidence from being conflated.
boundary: No literature theorem, TECT claim, QFT result, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or Yang--Mills obligation is closed by this policy.
next_action: Apply the policy at the next gate-level synthesis: add the prior-work/applicability/contribution sections and run the reference-completeness audit before issuing a publication PDF.
no_overclaim: The policy records how to document and audit literature; it does not establish novelty or source absence.

qft_interface.closed: Reference provenance and applicability recording rules are now explicit for manifests, certificates, claim cards, exploration records and synthesis PDFs.
qft_interface.open: Selected-source completion, C4/C5/C6 applicability audits, external review and all mathematical QFT gates remain open.
qft_interface.route: source discovery -> precise citation/locator -> hypothesis crosswalk -> applicability disposition -> internal proof or explicit non-applicability -> gate-level synthesis references.

adversarial_review.check: A source citation is never treated as a TECT proof or applicability result without a hypothesis crosswalk.
Search limits and zero results are recorded as bounded discovery, not evidence of literature absence.
Superseded/refuted legacy conclusions remain reference-only until current-owner revalidation.
Intermediate T0 records may lack a full bibliography, but a gate-level synthesis PDF cannot pass reference-completeness with missing load-bearing locators.
